Materials and Methods

Eluent A: water with 0.1% formic acid. Eluent B: acetonitrile.

The flow rate was 0.9 mL/min and the column temperature was 30 C.

During optimization, Table 1 summarizes screened gradient candidates.

Table 1. Optimization gradient candidates.
Time %B
0.0 5
10.0 95

The selected method used a gradient of 10 to 64% B over 30 min, hold 5 min, return to initial over 1 min.
